elsewhere.note: When the people heard this evil news, they mourned; and no one put on his jewelry.
You daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you delicately in scarlet, who put ornaments of gold on your clothing.
Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
Lift up your eyes all around, and see: all these gather themselves together, and come to you. As I live,” says Yahweh, “you shall surely clothe yourself with…
“Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without number.
